response.sql: SELECT operation, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS large_transaction_count FROM trans WHERE amount > 2400 GROUP BY operation

assumptions.assumption: A large transaction is one with amount strictly greater than 2400 (the request says 'cutoff' without saying whether the boundary is inclusive).

Sign comes from trans.type: PRIJEM is positive, VYDAJ is negative, and the stored unsigned amount is negated for VYDAJ. Rows of any other type (such as VYBER) are excluded from the average through the CASE returning NULL, but they still count in large_transaction_count.
Rows with a NULL operation fall into one group, because GROUP BY places all NULLs together, and that group is shown with operation NULL.
A group whose rows are all of a type other than PRIJEM or VYDAJ returns a NULL average.

alternatives.interpretation: A large transaction is one at or above 2400 (inclusive cutoff), with the same signed average and counts.
